# GTA VI Playthrough Tracker

> Free, single-page companion for Grand Theft Auto VI story mode: a per-chapter checklist of all 102 missions plus missable items, a money-making guide, an interactive map of Leonida (the game's state) with supercar spawns, hide spots and secrets, and reference lists of cheat codes and trophies. Progress is stored locally in the visitor's browser; no account, no tracking.

URL: https://runeball.no/GTAVI/
Source code (MIT): https://github.com/runeballe/GTAVI

## Sections (tabs on the page)

- [Checklist](https://runeball.no/GTAVI/#checklist): 5 chapters, 102 required missions, finds, side jobs, missables flagged, plus all 65 Strangers & Freaks side missions grouped by contact; filter by open/done/missable; search.
- [Money Fast](https://runeball.no/GTAVI/#money): money-making methods by chapter (e.g. Moses' garage car loop in chapter 2).
- [Live Map](https://runeball.no/GTAVI/#map): Leaflet map on real in-game coordinates. Pin categories: supercars (13, e.g. Truffade Thrax — fastest car, garage code 8554013), chapter guide items, hide & money spots, secrets (UFO, tower egg), and ~1,200 gtadb.org landmarks.
- [Leonida](https://runeball.no/GTAVI/#leonida): guide to the State of Leonida — 5 counties (Vice-Dale, Kelly, Leonard, Mariana, Lummox) and 11 cities/towns (Vice City, Vice Beach, Hamlet, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Waning Sands, Vinewood Beach, Capri, Key Lento, Southwind, Millport) with real-world inspirations, highlights and map links.
- [Vehicles](https://runeball.no/GTAVI/#vehicles): gallery of ~300 GTA VI vehicles by class (new vs returning, model year), with links to gta.wiki and to known spawns on the map.
- [Weapons](https://runeball.no/GTAVI/#weapons): gallery of 74 GTA VI weapons by class, from melee to launchers.
- [Cheats](https://runeball.no/GTAVI/#cheats): all 61 story-mode cheats with unlock conditions; 21 known d-pad codes, cross-checked across sources. Unlock checklist with progress counter. Enter on the phone: hold LB + press RB (Xbox) or L1 + R1 (PS5).
- [Trophies](https://runeball.no/GTAVI/#trophies): 55 trophies / 1,000 Gamerscore with descriptions; tick off as earned.

## Data sources

- Map tiles and landmark coordinates: gtadb.org contributors (CC BY 4.0) — https://gtadb.org
- Cheats and trophies: leonidaverse.com codex (unofficial fan wiki), cross-checked with gta.wiki and launch-week cheat guides
- Leonida places, vehicles and weapons: gta.wiki (Vehicles_in_GTA_VI, Weapons_in_GTA_VI)
- Guide tips: community sources (Reddit, X, Skycoach, G2A, Insider Gaming, VICE, Space4Games, Rock Paper Shotgun)

## Notes

- Unofficial fan project; not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
- Some guide texts use older GTA V-era area names (e.g. "Vespucci"); those map pins are approximate.
